stem.text: Menthol is a naturally occurring alcohol.

stem.alt: Skeletal structure of menthol, labelled menthol: a cyclohexane ring with a methyl group on the top carbon, an OH group on the right-hand carbon and an isopropyl group on the bottom carbon, next to the OH-bearing carbon.

stem.text: When menthol is heated with concentrated sulfuric acid it reacts. The products formed include compound T.
What is the structure of compound T?

A.alt: Skeletal structure of a cyclohexane ring with an exocyclic C=C double bond to an isopropylidene group, plus a methyl group (option A).

B.alt: Skeletal structure of a cyclohexanone-type ring with a C=O group, a methyl group and an isopropyl group (option B).

C.alt: Skeletal structure of a cyclohexene ring with a C=C double bond in the ring, a methyl group and an isopropyl group (option C).

D.alt: Skeletal structure of a cyclohexene ring with a C=C double bond in the ring, a methyl group and an isopropyl group (option D).
